metadata.purpose: Storage probe I2/I3: introspection must report a column's type, nullability and default, and must distinguish a UNIQUE index from a plain one. REG-129 was exactly that bug on one engine; a hand-written CREATE TABLE would test the test's SQL rather than NPDev's realized schema.
metadata.seedPath: Rows are seeded through the generated app's own CRUD endpoint, which is why this concept carries a ui label: without one the app emits no such endpoint and Tier C's seed 404s. Inserting over JDBC instead would prove the rows survive, but not that the platform wrote them (storage/OPEN_ITEMS_PLAN.md 5.1).
